parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

get.description: All Work Breakdown Structure codes for a given project

parameters.name: can_select_divisions
parameters.description: If true, will include WBS Codes with division segment items. Default is true.

parameters.name: required_segments
parameters.description: Filters results to include only WBS codes that have at least one segment item for each of the specified segment types. Valid values: 'cost_code', 'line_item_type'. Pass multiple values to require more than one segment type.

parameters.name: filters[status][]
parameters.description: Filter results to only return codes with the included statuses. Options are 'active' or 'inactive'. Defaults to returning all results.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description: Filter results to only return codes that were updated within the range of the two specified ISO 8601 timestamps separated by the ... delimiter.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Filter results to only return codes that match the specified WBS scope.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Searches the WBS code and description values and returns results sorted in descending order of relevance to the search query.

parameters.name: group_type
parameters.description: Along with 'group_id', groups WBS codes by the specified group type and group ID. Only supported option is 'contract'.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Along with 'group_type', groups WBS codes by the specified group type and group ID. Only supported option is a contract ID.

parameters.name: hide_not_in_group
parameters.description: If true, will hide WBS codes that are not in the specified 'group_type' and 'group_id'. Default is true. If false, WBS codes in the specified group will be returned first followed by WBS codes not in the group.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the Work Breakdown Structure code. Use as the {id} path parameter in PATCH /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/work_breakdown_structure/wbs_codes/{id}.

flat_code.description: The Work Breakdown Structure code made up of segment values, concatenated by the set delimiter. Use this value to display or identify a WBS code.

flat_name.description: The names of the Work Breakdown Structure segments concatenated using the company's delimiter and WBS pattern.

description.description: Description of the WBS code. Falls back to flat_name when no custom description  has been set.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the WBS code. One of: 'active' (available for use in budgets and line items), 'inactive' (not available for selection). Filter collections with filters[status][]=active or filters[status][]=inactive.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this WBS code was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this WBS code was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

segment_items.description: The segment items that make up this WBS code, one per segment in the WBS pattern. Each item represents a cost code, line item type, sub-job, or custom segment item.

id.description: Unique ID of this segment item (cost code, sub-job, line item type, or custom segment item). Use as segment_item_id when constructing a new WBS code via POST /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/work_breakdown_structure/wbs_codes.

path_ids.description: Ordered list of IDs from the root ancestor down to (and including) this segment item. Use to reconstruct the full hierarchy path.

path_code.description: Full path code for this segment item representing the leaf code in its hierarchy (e.g., '01-222').

is_parent.description: Whether this segment item has child items in a tiered segment structure. Always false for flat-structure segments.

path_names.description: Ordered list of name strings from the root ancestor down to (and including) this segment item, formatted as 'code - name'.

segment_items.description: The segment items that make up this WBS code, one per segment in the WBS pattern. Each item represents a cost code, line item type, sub-job, or custom segment item.

id.description: Unique ID of this segment item (cost code, sub-job, line item type, or custom segment item). Use as segment_item_id when constructing a new WBS code via POST /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/work_breakdown_structure/wbs_codes.

code.description: Short alphanumeric code for this segment item (e.g., '01-222'). Combined with sibling segment codes to form the flat_code on the parent WBS code.

name.description: Human-readable name of this segment item (e.g., 'Lighting'). Combined with sibling segment names to form the flat_name on the parent WBS code.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this segment item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this segment item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent segment item in a tiered segment hierarchy. Null for root-level items or items in a flat-structure segment.

path_ids.description: Ordered list of IDs from the root ancestor down to (and including) this segment item. Use to reconstruct the full hierarchy path.

path_code.description: Full path code for this segment item representing the leaf code in its hierarchy (e.g., '01-222').

is_parent.description: Whether this segment item has child items in a tiered segment structure. Always false for flat-structure segments.

path_codes.description: Ordered list of code strings from the root ancestor down to (and including) this segment item, formatted as 'code - name'.

path_names.description: Ordered list of name strings from the root ancestor down to (and including) this segment item, formatted as 'code - name'.

in_use.description: Whether this segment item is currently referenced by at least one entity (e.g., a budget line item or WBS code).

segment.description: The WBS segment definition that this segment item belongs to.

id.description: Unique ID of the WBS segment definition.

name.description: Display name of the segment (e.g., 'Cost Code', 'Sub Job').

type.description: Category of this segment. One of: 'cost_code', 'line_item_type', 'sub_job', 'custom', 'attribute'. Determines which domain entity backs the segment items.

position.description: Display order of this segment within the WBS pattern. Lower numbers appear first when reading the flat_code left to right.

delimiter.description: Character used to separate this segment's value from adjacent segments in the flat_code (e.g., '.').

required.description: Whether this segment must have a value for a WBS code to be valid.

segment_items_count.description: Total number of segment items defined for this segment.

project_can_modify_origin_project.description: Whether project-level users can modify segment items that originated from this project.

project_can_delete_origin_company.description: Whether project-level users can delete segment items that originated from the company level.

structure.description: Hierarchy structure of the segment. 'flat' means items have no parent-child relationship; 'tiered' means items can be nested with parent_id references.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this segment definition was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this segment definition was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

wbs_pattern_id.description: ID of the WBS pattern this segment belongs to.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the segment item. One of: 'active' (available for selection when creating WBS codes), 'inactive' (not available for new WBS codes).

wbs_pattern_id.description: ID of the WBS pattern that defines the segment structure for this code. All WBS codes under the same project share the same wbs_pattern_id.

attribute_items.description: Custom attribute items assigned to this WBS code. Only present when the project has WBS attributes configured. Empty array when no attributes are assigned.

attribute_id.description: ID of the WBS attribute definition.

id.description: ID of the WBS attribute item.

name.description: Display name of the assigned attribute item (a value within an attribute, e.g. 'Labor').

is_in_group.description: Whether this WBS code belongs to the group specified by the group_type and group_id query parameters. Only present when the group_type query parameter is provided;  group_id is optional.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"description\":\"Project A - Building B - Room C\",\"status\":\"inactive\",\"default_uom_id\":5}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/work_breakdown_structure/wbs_codes/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
